problem_type: Catalog insertions silently change automatic paid text model selection.
symptom: A fresh APIMart-only catalog selects GPT-6 Astra for plain text instead of DeepSeek V4 Pro. Disabling Pro also bypasses V4 Flash.
direct_cause: The generic text penalty ties current chat rows; stable sorting then follows the seed or persisted insertion order.
class_root: The declared plain-text default and backup were represented only by row position.
affected_population: APIMart fresh and upgraded catalogs and disabled model rows
Automatic Agent and text-node selection; explicit vendor/model identities and automatic image choice are separate inputs.
entry_points: Default/readiness and follow-Agent text node selection via selectTextModelCandidates
internal_only_reason: Catalog positioning and the chosen defaults are Nomi product policy; recorded in apimartTexts before this PR and the design card.
invariants: Availability is filtered first. Explicit preference and image ranking retain their own policies. Plain text priorities have vendor-local scope.

door_reduction.why_not: These are callers and tests of one resolver; all consume the same sorting policy.

generality_proof: Vendor-local priorities select the declared text primary and backup across permutations without reordering independent vendors. Unmarked ordinary models retain stable order.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Orders automatic plain-text candidates in vendor-local slots; the common resolver calls it only with usable models and no explicit preference.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Delegates all candidate selection to selectTextModelCandidates.
Configured default and follow-Agent paths call selectTextModelCandidates.

recurrence.reason: Every catalog insertion and every pre-existing row ordering can change the winner.
same_class_scan: Checked Agent lane chooseTextModel, configured default, follow-Agent path and readiness agreement.
Checked renderer useAgentPanelV4Data; it keeps no implicit model when the preference is empty.

prevention.invariant: Only usable plain-text candidates from the same vendor can exchange priority.
prevention.failure_mode: An unavailable preferred row remains excluded; explicit unavailable identities fail using the existing resolver contract.
prevention.strategy: Read the declared ordinary-text rank at the shared automatic resolver after availability and outside explicit/image paths.

legacy_paths.rationale: Unqualified raw order as the sole tie breaker for ordinary automatic text is replaced. Unmarked models retain stable order.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The resolver and seed policy are internal product decisions.

migration: Existing seed reconciliation adds code-owned metadata to the same model keys without toggling enabled state or changing user preferences.
residual_risks: No cloud billing or provider retest; regression checks derive the selected identity locally.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Both the shared resolver and full fresh/upgrade catalog selections exercise the ordering invariant.
